value.rationale: The diamond is the smallest Boolean target with two incomparable successors, so its local back-lifting bifurcation is a meaningful structural departure from chain targets. The explicit complete finite invariant for a five-atom source gives 288524 fixed-label morphisms but only 1918 source/target symmetry classes; computing these motivates and tests the boundary theorem in a natural Dedekind-size family.
